drhp.business: MRIL delivers specialized engineering solutions for structural safety, durability and life-extension of buildings and infrastructure assets, serving residential, commercial, industrial, institutional and government clients across India. Its disciplined project delivery model spans works contracts (structural repairs, waterproofing, retrofitting, high-risk stabilization), corporate interiors, infrastructure rehabilitation (bridge decks, flyover expansion joints), PPP/BOT evaluation, and a patented construction & demolition (C&D) waste management solution.
drhp.expansion: The Company entered a Joint Venture Agreement on 23 August 2024 with M/s Ravi Enterprises (through Mr. Vimal Sunil Chavan) to execute the Thane Municipal Corporation project 'Renovation and Improvement of Ram Ganesh Gadkari Rangayatan', in which MRIL holds a 51% interest. No investment or capital contribution had been made as of 31 March 2026; the Board has approved making the necessary investment/contribution during FY 2026-27, subject to statutory and regulatory approvals.

litigation.note: The statutory auditor's report (Annexure B, para XIX and the 'other legal and regulatory requirements' section) states the Company does not have any pending litigations which would impact its financial position; separately, Annexure B lists disputed Service Tax and GST demands pending before Appellate Authorities/Tribunal and CIT Appeal across multiple past financial years.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- customer lock-in: Registered vendor status with government bodies, municipal corporations and public sector undertakings, complemented by a growing portfolio of private corporate clients — evidence: diversified public & private client base disclosed under Opportunities in the MD&A.
- scale: Proven track record acts as a reference point and entry barrier for competitors — evidence: more than 500 projects completed across residential, commercial, industrial, institutional and government sectors by a team of over 120 professionals.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Infrastructure projects are capital-intensive; delayed public-sector billing timelines and retention monies can stretch the Company's working capital cycles.
- Since listing on the NSE SME platform, the Company's equity shares have faced typical short-term market volatility.
- Delay in project execution due to factors beyond the Company's control, including availability of resources, weather conditions, approvals and client-side dependencies, may impact timelines.
- Operations are subject to statutory and regulatory requirements relating to construction activities, labour laws, environmental regulations and contractual obligations; changes in requirements or delays in approvals may impact project execution.
- The Company's risk management policy flags significant weakening in demand from core end-markets, inflation uncertainties and adverse regulatory developments as key risks it monitors, though the year's risk assessment noted no major risks.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue to operate across structural Repairs, Rehabilitation, Retrofitting, Waterproofing, BOT projects, Infrastructure Restoration, Corporate Interior, Works Contract, Maintenance Construction Services and Waste Management, with no change in the nature of business during the year.
- Pursue the Thane Municipal Corporation joint-venture project (Renovation and Improvement of Ram Ganesh Gadkari Rangayatan) via a 51%-held JV with M/s Ravi Enterprises, with the Board approving investment/contribution into the JV during FY 2026-27.
